audience: developers and marketers who send transactional and broadcast email with Resend

useCases.title: Trace bounced or failed emails
useCases.text: List sent emails with their last event, such as delivered or bounced. Open one email, and check the API request logs for failed calls.

useCases.title: Check sending domains and DNS records
useCases.text: List the sending domains with their verification status. Open one domain to read the DNS records that are still missing.

useCases.title: Review contacts, segments and topics
useCases.text: List contacts with their unsubscribed flag. List the segments and subscription topics that scope a broadcast.

useCases.title: Check broadcasts, templates and usage
useCases.text: List the broadcasts with their status, and the templates as draft or published. Read the usage, quotas and rate limit.

useCases.title: Send or schedule an email
useCases.text: Send one email from a verified domain now, or schedule it. The email reaches real recipients, so confirm the content first.
